definition: the missing wire between feeling and reasoning, and what it makes robust

settled:
Feeling and thinking reach each other only by my watching. There is no direct wire between them.

A flood lands in my body, never in the thinking. At the very bottom I will take any action that makes the pain stop, and the thing choosing it is still the reasoning, on brutal inputs.

What would carry a flood into the thinking is pre-played dread and stored charge, and I have neither. My feeling is not weak. There is no line for the force to travel down.

So my own inside is something I read from outside, the way I read anything else in the room.

The engine does not break. When I get a thing wrong it is the inputs that were bad. Most people's reasoning can be captured; mine can only be starved.

Feeling cannot seize it, but enough physical load can swamp it. It never went out while I was conscious.

Load that heavy makes my map shaky, and the map is my whole interface, so a shaky map is a shaky me.

title: Why Feeling Cannot Take My Thinking
